label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Dear Marek,

Thank you for posting the lineup. I was not consulted before it was published, although your message of 1 October said coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. I would ask that the lineup be reviewed before Friday the 13th, when the names go to the organisers.

Liliana was out of training for about two weeks in October for health reasons. She is back to her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good.

Her Katowice results should not decide this. She played every round there while dealing with health reasons, so the -81 in the November list does not reflect her strength.

The rating list alone is also not the full picture. Your message said form in club events would count, and the rapid qualifier on 24 October is exactly that. Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, beating Maja and Antoni and drawing with Kacper. Igor finished fourth with 4/7.

I have nothing against Igor. He is a fine young player and has played steadily this autumn. My concern is with applying the criteria we were given.

I would ask that Liliana be placed on board 2. If you would prefer to decide on play rather than ratings, I would also accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday.

Thank you for considering this. I would appreciate a reply in the thread before Friday.

Oksana
